name: Collection (CIA Training Game)
description: CIA-developed intelligence collection training board game originally used internally and later released through a FOIA request. Models the complex and chaotic dynamics of human intelligence (HUMINT) operations, including source recruitment, asset handling, cover maintenance, and counterintelligence threats. Designed to develop tradecraft intuition in intelligence officers.
general_score_metric: mission_success_rate / outcome-based metrics (game score, mission completion)
reputation: historically significant as an internal CIA training tool; gained public attention after FOIA release; referenced in intelligence education literature
notes: Released via FOIA request; exact year of original publication uncertain. Rules available publicly following declassification. Used to train case officers in source recruitment and clandestine operations tradecraft.
